questions.prompt: Mr. Kashaulo treats sick patients in a hospital. What is he? (A Doctor, B Plumber, C Surgeon, D Driver)
steps: Treating patients identifies the general occupation doctor; the sentence does not specify surgery.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: A. Doctor (best general answer); a surgeon is also a type of doctor.

questions.prompt: The clock reads 12:00. What time is it? (A Half past one, B quarter past one, C quarter to one, D twelve o'clock)
steps: The hour is 12 and the minutes are 00.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Mariam is Musa's daughter and her son is John. Who is John to Musa? (A Nephew, B Grandfather, C Grandson, D Granddaughter)
steps: John is the son of Musa's daughter, so he is one generation below Musa's child.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Who repairs pipes? (A Doctor, B Plumber, C Cobbler, D Shoeshine)
steps: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: There are many ___ in the forest. (A Mouse, B Mouses, C Mice, D Mices)
steps: The irregular plural of mouse is mice.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the plural of tooth.
steps: Change the vowel sound in the irregular plural tooth -> teeth.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Your father's sister is your ___.
steps: A parent's sister is an aunt.

questions.prompt: What is the sound of a dog called?
steps: A dog barks.

questions.prompt: The young one of a duck is a ___.
steps: Duckling is the name of a young duck.

questions.prompt: A person who flies an aeroplane is a ___.
steps: A pilot operates an aircraft.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: A person who controls a ship is a ___.
steps: The captain commands a ship; a helmsman specifically steers it.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write a word rhyming with week.
steps: Week and seek share the ending /i:k/; other correct rhymes are acceptable.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is the sound of a snake called?
steps: A snake hisses.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We say ___ when we make a mistake.
steps: Sorry is an apology.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The son or daughter of your uncle is your ___.
steps: Your uncle's child is your cousin.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Sharon is peeling an orange ___ a knife. (A and, B by, C with, D in)
steps: Use with to name a tool used for an action.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Does Pendolina ___ food every day? (A cooks, B cook, C cooked, D cooking)
steps: After does use the base verb without s.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Pili is ___ than Amina. (A Shorter, B Short, C Shortest, D Shoertest)
steps: Than compares two people, so use the comparative.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Weak is for week; right is for ___. (A night, B might, C quite, D write)
steps: Right and write are homophones.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: This pen is mine but that ruler is ___. (A you, B your, C yours, D yourself)
steps: Use the possessive pronoun yours when no noun follows.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Good children ___ breaking school regulations. (A Hated, B hate, C are hated, D hating)
steps: A plural subject takes the base present form hate for a general habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We sometimes ___ our grandfather during holidays. (A Visit, B Visits, C Visited, D Visiting)
steps: We takes visit for a present habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She likes ___ books in the library. (A Reads, B Reading, C Read, D Readed)
steps: Likes can be followed by the -ing activity reading.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We are eating chips ___ forks. (A By, B On, C With, D And)
steps: With introduces the utensils used.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The commissioner is guarded by a ___ of soldiers. (A Group, B Army, C Troop, D Cluster)
steps: A troop is a group of soldiers; group and army can also be meaningful at different scales.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: C. Troop (most specific intended collective noun).
